verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing docs confirm 3DS enrollment via API (OTP and out-of-band authentication) and card lifecycle management (activate/suspend/close, balance account updates) through the API, avoiding support tickets. However, there is no explicit documentation of PIN set/reset API flows in the evidence pack. missing for 10: PIN set/reset API endpoint documentation, confirmation that PIN management is self-service via API rather than Customer Area/support.
